 "rationale": "Ahuja Cc sends compensation current into a ground-referenced cascode node. The gate is not tied to vout, so it tracks vin and PSRR stays near (beta*Gm)/(gp*gds/gm) ≈ 65 dB at 1 kHz. Cc/C1 gain moves the gate about 4x the vout dip, which keeps undershoot low. Cc sets damping (zeta) at 95 uA light load. Cm damps heavy load. Iq = 10 uA IREF + 8 uA tail + 45 uA divider = 63 uA."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid_p": (10.0, 7.0, 14.0),     # pass device gm/Id at ILOAD_MAX
    "Lp":     (0.15, 0.15, 0.3),     # pass L
    "gmid1":  (22.0, 16.0, 26.0),    # input pair gm/Id (weak inversion -> low VGS, tail headroom)
    "L1":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),       # input pair L
    "gmid_m": (10.0, 7.0, 14.0),     # PMOS mirror gm/Id
    "Itail":  (8e-6, 4e-6, 16e-6),   # EA tail current
    "Idiv":   (45e-6, 25e-6, 50e-6), # divider current (also min pass current -> light-load gm)
    "zeta":   (0.45, 0.25, 0.8),     # light-load damping of the Ahuja minor loop (sets Cc)
    "Cm":     (1.0e-12, 0.2e-12, 3e-12),  # plain Miller gate->vout (heavy-load damping)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VIN = 1.8
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vref = spec["vref"]; vo = spec["vout_target"]
    beta = vref / vo
    Imax, Imin, CL = spec["iload_max"], spec["iload_min"], spec["cl"]
    It, Idiv = p["Itail"], p["Idiv"]
    Ih = It / 2.0

    # ---------------- pass device (heavy load sizing) ----------------
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], Imax, vds=VIN - vo)
    Wp, Lp = mp.W, p["Lp"]
    g_heavy = VIN - mp.vgs                     # gate voltage at 5 mA

    def pid(v):
        try:
            return abs(lut.op("p", Wp, Lp, v, VIN - vo)["Id"])
        except Exception:
            return 0.0
    def vsg_for(I):
        lo, hi = 0.2, 1.8
        for _ in range(60):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            if pid(mid) < I: lo = mid
            else: hi = mid
        return 0.5 * (lo + hi)
    I_light = Imin + Idiv
    vsg_l = vsg_for(I_light)
    opl = lut.op("p", Wp, Lp, vsg_l, VIN - vo)
    gm2L = max(abs(opl["gm"]), 1e-6); gds2L = abs(opl["gds"]); cggL = abs(opl["cgg"])
    dVg = max(mp.vgs - vsg_l, 0.05)

    # ---------------- bias: stacked diodes on IREF ----------------
    gb, Lb = 20.0, 1.0
    mbb = lut.size("n", gb, Lb, iref, vds=0.45)
    mbb = lut.size("n", gb, Lb, iref, vds=mbb.vgs)            # nb = VGS_b (~0.45 V)
    mba = lut.size("n", gb, Lb, iref, vds=0.5, vsb=mbb.vgs)   # ibias = VGS_b + VGS_a (cascode gate)
    mt  = lut.size("n", gb, Lb, It, vds=0.12)                 # tail mirror (same gm/Id, L as MBb)

    # ---------------- error amplifier ----------------
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Ih, vds=0.3, vsb=0.1)
    m6 = lut.size("n", gb, Lb, Ih, vds=0.3, vsb=mbb.vgs)      # cascodes: same density as MBa -> X ~ nb
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_m"], 2.0, Ih, vds=0.9)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_m"], 2.0, Ih, vds=m4.vgs)
    vtail = vref - m1.vgs
    vx = (mbb.vgs + mba.vgs) - m6.vgs

    # ---------------- compensation ----------------
    Cm = p["Cm"]
    C1 = cggL + Cm
    gm6 = m6.gm
    Cc = math.sqrt(gm6 * C1 * CL / gm2L) / (2.0 * p["zeta"])
    Cc = min(max(Cc, 1e-12), 40e-12)
    w0L = math.sqrt(gm2L * gm6 / (C1 * CL))
    wu = beta * m1.gm / (Cc + Cm)

    # ---------------- divider ----------------
    R2 = vref / Idiv
    R1 = R2 * (vo / vref - 1.0)

    # ---------------- netlist ----------------
    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    mfp = int(min(200, max(1, round(Wp / 10.0))))
    n.dev("MP", "vout", "gate", "vin", "vin", mp, m=mfp)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vin", "vin", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "gate", "d1", "vin", "vin", m4)
    n.dev("M5", "d1", "ibias", "x1", "vss", m6)       # matched cascode on diode side (kills sys. offset)
    n.dev("M6", "gate", "ibias", "x", "vss", m6)      # Ahuja cascode
    n.dev("M1", "x1", "fb", "tail", "vss", m1)        # fb on diode side -> negative feedback
    n.dev("M2", "x", "vref", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "nb", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("MBA", "ibias", "ibias", "nb", "vss", mba)
    n.dev("MBB", "nb", "nb", "vss", "vss", mbb)
    n.R("R1", "vout", "fb", R1)
    n.R("R2", "fb", "vss", R2)
    n.C("CC", "vout", "x", Cc)
    n.C("CM", "gate", "vout", Cm)

    # ---------------- predictions ----------------
    gp = m4.gds
    gn = m6.gds * m1.gds / max(gm6, 1e-9)
    Aea = m1.gm / (gp + gn)
    load_reg = dVg / (beta * Aea) / (Imax - Imin)
    w1k = 2 * PI * 1e3
    inj_h = gp * mp.gds / mp.gm + w1k * (Cm + mp.cgd)
    inj_l = gp * gds2L / gm2L + w1k * (Cm + mp.cgd)
    inj = max(inj_h, inj_l)
    psrr = db(beta * m1.gm / inj)
    line_reg = max(gp * mp.gds / mp.gm, gp * gds2L / gm2L) / (beta * m1.gm)
    undershoot = 1.3 * C1 * dVg / (Cc + Cm) + Imax * 10e-9 / CL
    overshoot = Imax * 0.5 * (C1 * dVg / Ih) / CL
    iq = iref + It + Idiv

    return n, {
        "vout_err_pct": 0.2,
        "iq": iq,
        "psrr_1k": psrr,
        "line_reg": line_reg,
        "load_reg": load_reg,
        "undershoot": undershoot,
        "overshoot": overshoot,
        "ripple_settled": 2e-3,
        # diagnostics
        "Cc_pF": Cc * 1e12, "ugf_kHz": wu / (2 * PI) / 1e3, "f0_light_kHz": w0L / (2 * PI) / 1e3,
        "Aea_db": db(Aea), "vgate_heavy": g_heavy, "vx": vx, "vtail": vtail,
        "pass_W_um": Wp, "vsg_light": vsg_l,
    }
